title: Honestly:
body:
I NEVER write reviews, but I needed to share my experience with this app. I was going through a tough time when my friend sent me an invite. Thought it would be like the other apps that we used and got fastly bored of, but Finch proved me wrong. It actually made me want to do those tasks and not lie to it 😭
I love the fact it has suggestions, linking with friends and “Literally survive the day” task. 
I like the reward system.
The first aid kit helped me a bit at the moment of pure chaos in my head, even tho the breathing exercises don’t help me much, there are other ways this app can calm you down. 
Thank you, and please don’t ruin this app 💕🥹
author: Peony in pink 🌸
